title: Braised Callaloo Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew from the Philippines made with tender callaloo and flavorful braised beef.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add callaloo, tomatoes, salt, black pepper, and bay leaves.
5. Bring stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
6. Braise for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until callaloo is tender.
7. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
